description: A short code entered one character per cell, such as a one-time code sent by text message. The cells are real text fields in a labelled group with one tab stop. A typed character fills its cell and moves on, Backspace walks back, and a pasted or autofilled code spreads across the cells. The code is one string, submitted once under `name`. Focus is a gold ring on one cell, error crimson on every cell and valid green with a check, in the order ArenaInput states.

label.description: Names the code, such as "Verification code", drawn above the cells and the group's accessible name. Required, and guarded at runtime: a blank one throws, because nothing can derive what a code is for.

length.description: How many cells, one per character. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 reads as 6.

characters.description: Which characters a cell accepts, and which keypad a phone shows. A refused character changes nothing and fires no event.

masked.description: Hides what each cell holds, as a password field does.

value.description: The whole code. Absent, the cells hold what the person types; present, it controls them. A string shorter than `length` fills the first cells, and a character `characters` refuses is dropped.

hint.description: A line of help under the cells, and each cell's description. An error replaces it while one shows.

error.description: Controlled error message; the cells turn crimson and invalid, and the message describes each cell while it shows.

required.description: Marks the label and sets the native `required` on every cell, so a native submission refuses a code with an empty cell.

name.description: Submitted with the form as the whole code, once, through a hidden input. The cells carry no name, so a form never receives one character on its own.

autoComplete.description: The browser autofill hint, on every cell. A code that is not sent by text message, such as a device PIN, passes `off`.

change.description: The code after an edit, whatever its length; a refused character fires nothing.

complete.description: The code, when an edit makes it `length` characters long. Fires after `change`. A typed character fires it only when it completes the code anew. A paste or autofill of more than one character fires it whenever the code ends full. A `value` the host fills does not fire it.

blur.description: Focus left the group; carries the code. A move from one cell to another is not a blur.
